output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The issue is in the function: 'balanceOf[target] += mintedAmount; totalSupply += mintedAmount;'. mintedAmount is provided by the caller, allowing it to be of any value, and thus causing an overflow in balanceOf[target] if mintedAmount is large enough. This overflow can be exploited to increase the balance of any user to a target value, allowing attackers to steal funds.

The _transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The issue is in the function: 'require(balanceOf[_to] + _value > balanceOf[_to]);'. If _value is large enough, it can cause an overflow in balanceOf[_to], allowing attackers to decrease the balance of any user to a target value, allowing attackers to steal funds.
